name: meta_model
summary: Anchors the four permanent architectural invariants Tom flagged as 'always remember': (1) .bb is the universal compile target, (2) XML structure IS tensor information, (3) morph layers are the universal blend vocabulary, (4) polymorphism via kimi-MoE + crystal-chain retrieval. This card is not code — it's an architectural memo that the ops_dag references.
engine_pattern: anchor/memo — not executable; pointed at by other ops

1_bb_universal_compile_target.principle: Every computation that CAN be a .bb SHOULD be a .bb
1_bb_universal_compile_target.stack_machine: 7 frozen symbols (f ~ d l s a m) + 2 value types (Num f64, Hash [u8;32])
1_bb_universal_compile_target.determinism_axiom: same .bb + same seed.json = same crystal hash, always

2_xml_as_tensor_information.principle: XML/SVG nodes carry vector-shaped data; XML nodes act as MoE gating layers
mechanics: BLAKE3 hex of layer styles = cryptographic seal
Chromium SVG filters = hardware GPU compositor runtime
2_xml_as_tensor_information.engine_pattern: parser_cursor (XMLParser-shaped) walks JSONL the same way Godot XMLParser walks XML

3_morph_layer_vocabulary.principle: Photoshop/Hypershade layer-style vocabulary is the universal interlingua across surfaces

4_kimi_moe_polymorphism.principle: Stack our crystal-chain MoE on top of kimi's internal MoE — polymorphism through retrieval, not training
4_kimi_moe_polymorphism.mechanism: Same input → different specialist behavior depending on (vector, wave, time) coordinate from the crystal chain
4_kimi_moe_polymorphism.why_no_training_cost: Smartness grows from the retrieval index size, not from weight updates. kimi provides specialists; our MoE picks which fires.

inbound_callers: Every workflow_card emit step (must check invariant 3)
Every chain JSONL writer (must check invariant 2)
Every artifact publish (must check invariant 1 — eventual .bb target)

guarantees: These invariants override task-specific architecture decisions
When a future op contradicts an invariant, the invariant wins
Memory + agent_def + ops_dag placeholders all reference the same canonical text
Updates to invariants happen in ONE place (memory file) and propagate via agent_def regeneration
